$comment: The EU AI Act disclosure truth table (Art. 50(4), Art. 3(60)). Input: a media item’s four fields and its mediaType. Output: the word in <ui-ai> (null = no element) and its aria-description. Both renderers are tested against this file: ui/card/render.js aiLabel()/aiDescription(), and any port of them. Rows follow cms-browser-style docs/UMBRACOAI.md §8.3 (rows 1–8) and §8.4 (recordings). The options column was removed in @browser.style/ai 2.0 — migration.md.
